caseNames: Restore saved random mode without auto-playing; first start chooses a random song
Pause/resume retains both the random song and its playback position
Random start includes every track, including the first and last
Stop, rescan and folder changes all allow a fresh random start
Sequential start and pause/resume behavior remain unchanged
Switching to random before start takes effect; switching while paused does not skip
Random previous/next and automatic song end still choose a different song
A single track starts safely; an empty folder never assigns a bogus random index
Without a configured folder, start opens folder selection rather than playing
A rejected play can be retried without unexpectedly selecting another random song
Every player icon has SVG markup and agrees with the canonical generator and SVG exports
